items.t: Robinhood Has Slumped for a Year: Why Goldman Sachs Sees 41% Upside After Two Target Cuts
items.sum: Key TakeawaysGoldman Sachs cut its Robinhood price target to $115 from $128 on Nov. 13 and kept its Buy rating.

items.t: Robinhood Stocks Fall 3.87% as Crypto Volume Sinks 48% While Prediction Bets Jump 136%
items.sum: October data showed $15.1 billion in net deposits and record event-contract activity, but crypto trading slumped with Bitcoin.

items.t: Robinhood’s Prediction-Market Bets More Than Doubled as Crypto Trading Crashed
items.sum: Robinhood's newest product line is exploding while its old crypto engine sputters. A closer look at October's numbers shows whether one bet can cover the other, and which outside platform the whole story leans on.

items.t: HOOD's Securities Lending Revenues Slide 43% in October: Q4 at Risk?
items.sum: Robinhood's securities-lending revenues plunged 43% in October, pressuring NIR growth. Rising margin balances may offer some support in Q4.

items.t: Robinhood vs. Tradeweb: Which Fintech Stock is a Smarter Buy?
items.sum: HOOD offers faster growth potential and a lower valuation, while TW boasts steadier earnings momentum. Which fintech stock has the edge?

items.t: Robinhood Has the Most to Lose From Kalshi Charges: About 60% of Its Prediction Volume
items.sum: Key TakeawaysPolitico reports that a federal regulator has warned Kalshi of possible charges, and InGame estimated this summer that Robinhood sends about 60% of its prediction-market volume to Kalshi. Robinhood has more riding on Kalshi than any other listed company, while DraftKings runs its own exchange and competes with Kalshi.
